verdict.rationale: Jules has a documented API, authenticated with API keys, for building custom workflows and automating tasks like bug fixing and code review. Through the API you can create sessions, send messages, approve plans and set `automationMode` to auto-create PRs, so it runs headlessly in its own cloud VM without the web UI. A community user independently built an MCP server that dispatches Jules tasks through the API, and the GitHub "jules" label offers another trigger without the UI. Missing for 10: any documented CLI or CI integration (e.g., a GitHub Actions recipe), plus a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), so CI use is only implied by the API.
